lines: We went down to the basement of the church in which the sorcerer was said to have once resided.
Perhaps it had been built afterward, but things there looked much newer than the church building aboveground.
He wasn't wrong. The floor of the basement was indeed covered with blood.
The disgusting stench of blood assaulted our nostrils. It was still fresh.
The amount of blood was more than five, even ten people's worth. However, there was not a single corpse to be seen, which gave me even more of the creeps.
Was Shikanosuke okay with this sudden horror-film-like development?
Oh, no, he was already out like a light.
Hebiko rushed to take care of him.
Urrgh... I wanna go home already...
Man, are you really such a scaredy-cat, Shikanosuke-kun?
Kirara-senpai, not at all bothered by the sea of blood, spoke in amazement.
Don't worry, he's fine as he is. The more scared he is, the better he can fight.
Is that how that works? Weird.
Kirara-senpai tilted her head before looking around the blood-spattered room.
Those guys, er, ghouls, from earlier used to live here I guess.
Like... when they were normal humans you mean...?
Right, right. Haaah, I pity them, really.
Some refugees began to use this basement as a den and ended up discovering the secret chamber by accidentー That'd be my guess.
Annreed pointed toward the back of the cellar where a broken wall could be seen.
And beyond the rubble were old stone walls and a staircase that led further down to another basement.
Whelp, nowhere to go but down. Are you okay now, Shikanosuke?
I don't know what part of this is okay, but... well... I'll manage somehow...
Shikanosuke looked as pale as a ghost himself as he spoke.
Alright, listen up. Our opponent is an unknown sorcerer. We don't know what they've got waiting for us down there so we're going in with a proper formation.
Oh, me, me! I'll take the vanguard!
Kirara-senpai's hand shot up before anyone else's.
Don't worry, I was just getting to that. Please take vanguard with Hebiko.
Hebiko will search for the enemy with her suckers, and Kirara-senpai will handle close-quarters combat.
Well, searching for the enemy is Hebiko's specialty after all...
Kirara-senpai and Hebiko noddedーone with pride, and the other with a bit of a discontented look.
H-Hey, Fuma, um... Do you think I can be in the middle of the formation... like the very middle?
You'll be on rear guard with Chevalier. I'm counting on your Electric Jutsu for the enemy search. Please watch our backs.
Give it up, Shikanosuke-chan. You know how stubborn Fuma-chan can be when it comes to efficiency during missions.
Chevalier is fine with that as well. Slow and steady, as they say. I'll just follow behind everyone.
I take it that means I'm with you in the middle guard then, huh?
Pretty clever, trying to pair up with me. Do you like me that bad?
Snuggling up close to me, Annreed prodded me with her elbow.
What the hell, Fuma!? So that's what you were planning!!
You were!? You're the worst, Fuma-chan!!
Kirara-senpai and Hebiko glared at me menacingly.
Shikanosuke was also giving me a reproachful look since I had just denied him his spot.
I-It's not like that!! I'm giving commands, that's why I'm in the middle! And so is Annreed since she can provide cover fire with her gun!
No need to be so coy about it.
I'm not being coy about anything! And hey, not so close!! Get away! Stop causing more trouble here!
I grabbed Annreed's arm, which was coiling around mine, and forcefully tore away her alluring body.
Annreed let out an unnaturally seductive voice and wriggled her body erotically.
Truth be told, I thought it was a shame, too.
But we still had a lair to explore here.
A-Alright. Anyway, that's what we're going with. Everyone, get ready.
Hebiko has the sudden urge to push Fuma-chan out to the front as a decoy...
Ooo, I like it! He can regenerate even if he gets injured after all. He'd be fine for a while.
This nasty conversation between the two vanguards continued as we went down the staircase.
Annreed and I were behind them, with Shikanosuke and Chevalier following behind us.
I felt like this team had its fair share of problems, yet we continued on down the staircase anyway.
What unfolded before my eyes was a sight beyond my imagination.
All thoughts of bickering and worry were completely blown from my mind by the breathtaking scenery before me.
It was something akin to enormous underground ruinsー
No, it actually was enormous underground ruins.
While everyone else was dumbstruck, Chevalier spoke with a satisfied tone in her voice.
These are real underground ruins from somewhere in the world. The sorcerer has forcefully warped space to connect it to that staircase.
Did you not feel that peculiar feeling in the pit of your stomach as we descended the stairs? That would be evidence of spatial distortion.
I mean, yeah, I did feel something a little strange, but...
The sorcerer who used to live here appears to be very skilled at manipulating space.
Chevalier has never seen this level of it before. Quite intriguing.
Chevalier's eyes were shining brighter than ever.
The sorcerer's magic seemed to be very... exhilarating for her.
Looks like the master of this place is a pretty big catch♪
I guess I can expect a big payout to match then.
Annreed also appeared to be excited in her own way.
So, what do we do, Fuma? This place is ridiculously massive. If we go around randomly we're more likely to just get lost.
The size of the ruins was one thing, but we didn't even know what kind of traps awaited us in here.
But just as we were getting ready to set up a temporary base...
Fuma-chan! There's some smell coming closer!
Hebiko suddenly shouted out a warning.
Hebiko hadn't forgotten to keep watch with her suckers even with the majesty of these ruins in front of her.
There's really bad smells mixed in. Something metallic, maybe iron? And...
Hebiko couldn't even finish the sentence as she puckered her face in disgust.
Shikanosuke's voice almost cracked from fear.
Setting aside the metallic smell, the rotten-meat-like one rang a bell.
I had experienced it many times ever since that CD Virus incident.
They always show up in these types of ruins. Like a combo set. And not the kind that you're happy to get...
I hate those guys. They're no fun to shoot.
Kirara-senpai and Annreed unenthusiastically took a fighting stance.
These guardians are so unrefined compared to the spatial manipulation exhibited earlier.
Even Chevalier seemed a bit disappointed.
What appeared from where Hebiko pointed was exactly what we all had expected.
Ah of course, so it was a golem made of iron that Hebiko smelled.
To the eyes of the monsters guarding the ruins, we were nothing but intrudersーtargets for elimination...
